lane_title: Basin Blind Lattice Infill — stratified 60/30/10 far/mid/near kernel-spaced lattice at b2 collar
hypothesis: Unmapped basin faults are missed by H33 ridge detector (0% flat-terrain dots vs 47% flat footprint); a stratified Poisson-disk lattice filling far-basin domain (d_cat>25px) at 2.83px spacing adds coverage where H33 is blind without re-adding near-catalogue FP.
mechanism: Distance-to-catalogue stratified greedy sampling: far 22592 dots (d>25px), mid 11296 (10-25px), near 3766 (2-10px), min spacing 2.83px (kernel-matched), b2 collar (d>2px), zeros-encoding (all finite [0,1], 0 outside footprint, nodata None, EPSG:32611 3730x3292 transform exact). No ML, no catalogue-derived features beyond stratification.
named_non_fault_process: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville pluvial shoreline benches: constant-elevation scarps with LiDAR curvature identical to fault scarps but no brittle offset and no basement gravity/magnetic step; filtered only by collar and far-basin prior.

holdout_progression.note: HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0000 is STRUCTURALLY ZERO for every file that respects the b2 (>2px) collar and >3px instrument halo (IR-88-35). The buffered whole-component holdout withholds catalogue components whose nearest visible fault lies ~12px away; a dot placed >2px from any mapped fault can never fall within the 3px kernel of a withheld component, so TP_w=0 by construction. This does not rank gate-clean files; the fleet distance fingerprint (Spearman +0.90) and SGMC proxy are the informative diagnostics for basin-infill hypotheses.

leakage_canary.note: Geometric lattice uses zero catalogue-derived features (only d_cat stratification for allocation); single-feature AUC trivially 0.50 PASS.

uniqueness.note: Literal 1.0 vs dense 17GEMSDOE (space-filling, halo 1.0) makes the literal >0.70 gate impossible for ANY nonempty candidate (IR-88-01, IR-88-76). Binding decision uses chance-corrected excess: worst excess -0.0519 <=0.70 PASS, worst |rho| 0.0449 <=0.90 PASS, so like-for-like PASS. Literal DUPLICATE is reported honestly but is vacuous.
